China Devalues Its Currency as Worries Rise About Economic Slowdown
headlines.abstract: The move appeared to be a response to signs that the economy was slowing too fast for comfort and could raise tensions with trading partners like the United States.

headlines.title: Wall St. Declines After China Devalues Its Currency
headlines.abstract: Prices for oil and copper fell sharply after China’s government lowered the value of its currency, suggesting weakness in the country’s economy.
